snippet.title: Oh Demon! Fix My TV - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018975

Spanish influencer and streamer Mister Jägger’s game, OH DEMON! Fix My TV, is coming to PlayStation 5 later this year! 📺😈

Get ready for a surreal first-person horror comedy where a simple TV repair turns into a bizarre journey full of strange puzzles, unexpected encounters, and demonic chaos.

Coming soon to PS5. https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018975 


#ps5 #ps5games
